UPI instant payments network grows from 1.78 cr annual transactions to 24,162 crore
description: India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is currently facilitating an impressive 66 crore transactions each day. Since 2016, the growth in its transaction volume has skyrocketed by an astounding 13,000 times. UPI has established itself as a foundational component of India's digital public infrastructure and has been recognized by the International Monetary Fund as the leading real-time payment system globally.

title: ‘Free water parks for kids’: AAP takes dig at Rekha Gupta govt over Delhi waterlogging
description: Heavy rainfall lashed Delhi on Monday afternoon, causing widespread waterlogging and traffic disruption.  Several key areas experienced significant water accumulation, impacting daily commutes and businesses.  An Aam Aadmi Party leader criticized the Delhi government's handling of the waterlogging situation.  The India Meteorological Department predicted continued light rain across various parts of the city.  Similar rainfall was reported across several other Indian states on Sunday.

title: What is the scholarship that awards students for playing games? Roehampton’s esports scheme puts gaming on the university balance sheet
description: Roehampton University’s esports scholarship is challenging traditional ideas about student funding by offering financial support to students who excel in competitive gaming while maintaining academic progress. The initiative comes as concerns over university costs intensify, highlighting a wider issue: many students remain unaware of scholarships and bursaries that could ease financial pressure and reduce reliance on additional work.

title: No relief for Rial: Iranian currency sinks to record low as US works on new sanctions
description: Iran's rial reached a record low as the United States prepared new economic sanctions.  Existing restrictions and a naval blockade have already severely impacted Iran's economy.  The currency's decline has not yielded concessions from the US President.  Iran and Oman are reportedly nearing an agreement on managing the Strait of Hormuz.  The United Arab Emirates suspended all trade with Iran following discussions with the US.

title: 'One tip one hand': English batter out in bizarre fashion in County match - Watch
description: Northamptonshire pacer Luke Procter bowled a short delivery that angled into left-handed Moores. The batter went back and defended the ball, which bounced close to the crease and appeared to be heading towards the stumps.

title: 'No sugar shortage': ISMA says India has enough stocks, prices to cool down soon
description: Industry representatives from India's sugar sector have assured that there is no shortage of sugar in the domestic market. The surge in retail prices is attributed to stockpiling speculation and adverse weather impacting production. To mitigate this, the government is facilitating duty-free sugar imports, particularly from Brazil, with some raw sugar expected to arrive before mid-October. Current domestic supplies are predicted to meet future demands adequately.

What Flock Safety CEO said on people vandalising Flock cameras across America
description: Flock Safety's CEO advocates for a compromise between privacy and public safety concerns.  The company faces criticism and vandalism over its surveillance technology deployment.  Reports detail police misuse of Flock cameras, prompting an apology from the CEO.  Flock has reduced data retention and requires case codes for access.  The CEO also calls for stronger regulations on surveillance data misuse.

title: 'We can ask Pakistan and request them': Kapil asks 'better treatment' for Imran
description: Former India captain Kapil Dev has joined 21 former international captains in urging Pakistan to provide jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan with proper medical care and humane conditions. The group has asked Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to follow court orders allowing medical treatment and weekly family visits. Kapil stressed that the appeal is about Khan’s health, not his legal cases.

title: MK Stalin moves HC against TVK MLA VS Babu's Kolathur win, seeks recount
Delhi-NCR rain: 10 videos capture waterlogging, traffic chaos across region
description: Heavy rain lashed Delhi-NCR on Monday, causing significant waterlogging across the region. Commuters faced severe traffic disruptions and slow movement on key roads and highways. Several areas reported knee-deep and waist-deep water, impacting daily commutes and vehicle movement. Flight operations were also disrupted, with fifteen Delhi-bound flights being diverted to other airports. The India Meteorological Department had issued red and orange alerts for the severe weather conditions.

title: Scientists overturned hundreds of rocks in Barbados and found the world's smallest snake
description: After a long absence of 20 years, scientists in Barbados have triumphantly rediscovered the world's tiniest snake, the Barbados threadsnake. This remarkable find, located under a rock during an ecological survey, measures just 3 to 4 inches long. The rediscovery is crucial for understanding the species' diminishing forest habitat, and conservationists are optimistic that this will bolster efforts to protect the remaining forests on the island.

title: Ajit Doval in Beijing as India-China border tensions rise; what's on agenda?
Scottish medallist goes back to McDonald's job days after Commonwealth Games
description: Scottish judoka Summer Shaw made headlines by winning a bronze medal at the Commonwealth Games, only to head back to her part-time McDonald's job to make ends meet for her sporting endeavors. Her engaging TikTok video on the matter caught widespread interest, highlighting her need for further financial support. Eager for sponsorship, she dreams of fully committing to her judo career.

title: Govinda-Sunita Ahuja unfollow each other on Instagram amid marriage trouble
description: Govinda and Sunita Ahuja are in the news amid marital discord, having unfollowed each other on Instagram. Sunita had filed for divorce in December 2024, citing adultery and cruelty, but has since withdrawn it. She reportedly told Rakhi Sawant that Govinda planned to remarry. Sunita also reacted sharply to Govinda's outing with co-star Komal Rani Swarnkar.

title: Bopanna blasts sports ministry rule as five tennis players miss Asian Games squad
description: The sports ministry's guidelines limited the Asian Games tennis squad to players ranked among the top eight in Asia. As a result, Manas Dhamne, Vaishnavi Adkar, Sahaja Yamalapalli, Vaidehee Chaudhari and Prarthana Thombare missed out on selection.

title: At 13, UAE student builds AI education platform: How did he do it?
description: At 13, UAE student Adam Ahmed developed ScoolBot, an AI-powered, gamified education platform aligned with UAE Ministry of Education standards. After his first project reached the Top 20 in a DDS AI challenge, ScoolBot placed fourth and later earned Gold at the International AI Awards 2026 and TeenTech Awards 2026. While developing the platform, Adam also created Bothread, a free, open-source tool that helps AI coding agents coordinate tasks and avoid conflicts.

title: ‘Most expensive’: Iran war, Hormuz closure forces India to pay high prices for LNG
description: State-backed energy companies are increasingly going to the spot LNG market and bidding up prices as the government seeks to support fertilizer producers that use natural gas.

title: Kashmiri Pandits under PM Package flag fresh threats; seek security
Meet India’s AI Kid: Kerala teenager builds AI tools while studying Commerce
description: Kerala teenager Raul John Aju, known as “Raul the Rockstar” and the “AI Kid of India”, has pursued artificial intelligence alongside his Commerce studies. A self-taught technology enthusiast, he has built AI tools, co-founded AIRealm Technologies, contributed to ThinkCraft Academy and conducted AI workshops for students and professionals. His journey, including claimed TEDx talks and a large online following, highlights how curiosity, experimentation and self-learning can create pathways into AI beyond traditional engineering and computer science routes.

title: Rashmika Mandanna makes 1st public appearance post hip injury with Vijay
description: After overcoming a painful hip injury, Rashmika Mandanna graciously stepped into the public eye, attending an engagement ceremony in Hyderabad alongside her husband, Vijay Deverakonda. The couple’s stylish matching dark outfits turned heads at the event. Rashmika, who recently updated her fans about her recovery journey on social media, is taking the time she needs to restore her health while resting at home.

title: ‘We'd be in office if educated’: Mumbai auto drivers block road over Marathi rule
description: Autorickshaw drivers in Mumbai began a three-day strike on Monday.  They are protesting the Marathi language requirement for their licenses.  Many older drivers lack formal education and struggle with the new rule.  Protesters face significant fines and demand reconsideration of the directive.  They seek justice and time to comply with the language mandate.

The party noted a significant increase in renovation and repair expenditures.  They are reviewing the Centre's commitments after withdrawing their nationwide agitation.  Any failure to honor assurances will be considered a betrayal of the youth.

title: Bollywood icon who wanted his house with no windows
description: Actor Abhay Deol has crafted a unique eco-friendly glass house in North Goa, defying traditional designs with a windowless approach. This innovative space is intended to provide a breezy outdoor ambiance within. The colorful furnishings and rustic touches make the expansive living room a perfect getaway, reflecting Abhay's desire to harmoniously blend his professional and personal worlds while staying true to his independent lifestyle.

title: 'Normal practice': Govt on Sergio Gor's 'no questions' remark at PM Modi-Trump meet
Rishabh Pant leapfrogs Shubman Gill to become India’s leading WTC run-scorer
description: Rishabh Pant has etched his name in cricket history as India's top scorer in World Test Championship, successfully surpassing Shubman Gill's record during the thrilling second Test against Sri Lanka. Moreover, he has broken MS Dhoni's record for the highest runs achieved by a wicketkeeper in away Tests, marking a triumphant return from injury.

title: From Porterville to Eureka: California’s cheapest cities to buy a house
description: In California's housing market, Porterville shines as the most affordable city with an average home price of just $325,000. Hot on its heels is Fresno, known for both its attractive home prices of around $388,567 and a thriving job sector. Bakersfield secures third place at $441,009 average, while Tulare, with its quaint town atmosphere, has homes averaging $458,693. Rounding out the list is Eureka, where average prices sit at $418,081.

title: Red, orange alerts in Delhi: 15 flights diverted amidst heavy rain, thunderstorms
description: On Monday, Delhi-NCR experienced torrential rainfall, leading to severe waterlogging and significant traffic disruptions. A total of fifteen flights had to be redirected from Delhi airport as severe weather conditions unfolded. Commuters took to social media, sharing snapshots of inundated streets and halted transportation. Many areas reported water buildup, hindering daily travel and services. Passengers were advised by airlines to verify flight statuses before heading to the airport.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay announces 3 LPG cylinders, free bus travel for women, transgenders
Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years
description: The Primary School, founded by Priscilla Chan, has closed after a decade of operation.  Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, leading to the board's decision.  Academic results fell short of state benchmarks and leadership expectations.  Around 540 students will now join the Ravenswood City Elementary School District.  The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative provided financial support for the transition and student savings.

title: Stamping of boarding passes for immigration clearance to be discontinued from Sept 1
description: From September 1, international travelers departing from India are set to benefit from a new policy that eliminates the necessity for boarding pass stamping at immigration counters. This initiative aims to enhance the efficiency of the travel process. Passengers have the option to present their boarding passes, either in electronic format or as a printed copy.

title: Wash rice twice, not 7 times: Drought-hit England targets faith, cultural habits
‘Voice of AMU’ page under scanner over abusive posts targeting teacher from northeast
description: An Aligarh Muslim University woman teacher was subjected to significant online abuse, centering on her private life and Northeastern heritage, which was littered with offensive slurs. She took an assertive step by reporting the harassment to the AMU proctor’s office. Consequently, an FIR was filed by the police, who are currently working to identify those responsible for the derogatory social media posts.
